pick.headline: Israel and the PLO sign the Gaza-Jericho agreement in Cairo
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of May 4, 1994, carried Cairo ESC Television live: Mubarak's speech at the signing in Cairo, hailing the Gaza-Jericho agreement as a 'historic moment' in the first phase of Palestinian-Israeli peace.

alternates.headline: Yugoslav President Tito dies
alternates.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of May 5, 1980, listed how bloc media broke the news of Tito's death: Tirana radio, Sofia radio with Zhivkov's condolences, and Czechoslovak reaction noting his achievements.

alternates.headline: Argentine Exocet strikes HMS Sheffield
alternates.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of May 5, 1982, listed under Argentina that a Super Etendard fired the missile at Sheffield, alongside claims of two Harriers downed, Belgrano survivors, and a protest note to Haig.
